## FAQ

## What level of protection do BulletSafe vests provide?

Most BulletSafe vests offer Level IIIA protection, capable of stopping handgun rounds up to a .44
Magnum. For higher threats, such as rifle rounds, BulletSafe provides Level III and Level IV
ballistic plates.


## Are BulletSafe vests stab-proof?

Yes, BulletSafe vests are rated to stop knives, razor blades, and even ice picks.

## How do I choose the right size vest?

BulletSafe offers a size chart based on height and weight to help determine the appropriate vest
size. It's important to refer to this chart, as vest sizing may differ from standard clothing sizes.


## What is BulletSafe's return policy?

Returns are accepted for items purchased directly from BulletSafe's website, provided they are in
new condition, postmarked within 7 days of receipt, and approved via a Return Authorization.

## FAQ

## What level of protection do BulletSafe vests provide?

Most BulletSafe vests offer Level IIIA protection, capable of stopping handgun rounds up to a .44
Magnum. For higher threats, such as rifle rounds, BulletSafe provides Level III and Level IV
ballistic plates.


## Are BulletSafe vests stab-proof?

Yes, BulletSafe vests are rated to stop knives, razor blades, and even ice picks.

## How do I choose the right size vest?

BulletSafe offers a size chart based on height and weight to help determine the appropriate vest
size. It's important to refer to this chart, as vest sizing may differ from standard clothing sizes.


## What is BulletSafe's return policy?

Returns are accepted for items purchased directly from BulletSafe's website, provided they are in
new condition, postmarked within 7 days of receipt, and approved via a Return Authorization.

## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

[See more FAQs][31]

update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

# Established in 2003, Zhejiang Light-Tough Composite Materials Co.,Ltd.

is a China leading manufacturer of bulletproof products, including bulletproof plate, bulletproof
vest, ballistic shield, bulletproof helmet and multi-protection vest. We LTCM also develops and
produces ballistic ceramics and high-performance fabrics used in manufacturing vehicle armor,
helicopter armor, fleet armor and security house. The products could be fully customized and
manufactured according to all international standards and End User specification. The company is
certified to ISO 9001 and CHINA GJB Standard. We have more than 19 years experience on bulletproof
R&D and manufacturing.

Covering an area of 16,000 square meters, we now have over 150 employees among which there are 4
doctorate, 5 masters and 20 bachelor degree. An annual sales figure that exceeds USD 2.5M and
currently exporting 80 percent of our production all over the world. We can produce 360 tons of
ceramic and 960,000 pcs of plate annually.

As a result of our high quality products and outstanding service, in past 3 years, we have gained a
global sales network reaching Turkey, France, Saudi Arabia, Africa, Korea, Indonesia, Mexico, USA
and so on.

With substantial experience in material science and practical applications of protective solutions,
Light-Tough is responsible for developing and providing the highest level of protective products to
military, police, law enforcement and civilians throughout the world.

## Frequently Asked Questions
* ### What is Netflix?
  
  Netflix is a streaming service that offers a wide variety of award-winning TV shows, movies,
  anime, documentaries and more – on thousands of internet-connected devices.
  
  You can watch as much as you want, whenever you want, without a single ad – all for one low
  monthly price. There's always something new to discover, and new TV shows and movies are added
  every week!
* ### How much does Netflix cost?
  
  New members can try 30 days of Netflix for ₹0. After the free trial ends, your plan will
  automatically renew at the regular price depending on the plan you select. Plans range from ₹149
  to ₹649.
  
  Watch Netflix on your smartphone, tablet, Smart TV, laptop or streaming device. No extra costs,
  cancel at anytime.
* ### Where can I watch?
  
  Watch anywhere, anytime. Sign in with your Netflix account to watch instantly on the web at
  netflix.com from your personal computer or on any internet-connected device that offers the
  Netflix app, including smart TVs, smartphones, tablets, streaming media players and game consoles.
  
  You can also download your favourite shows with the iOS or Android app. Use downloads to watch
  while you're on the go and without an internet connection. Take Netflix with you anywhere.
* ### How do I cancel?
  
  Netflix is flexible. You can easily cancel your account online in two clicks. There are no
  cancellation fees – start or stop your account anytime.
* ### What can I watch on Netflix?
  
  Netflix has an extensive library of feature films, documentaries, shows, anime, award-winning
  Netflix originals, and more. Watch as much as you want, anytime you want.
* ### Is Netflix good for kids?
  
  The Netflix Kids experience is included in your membership to give parents control while kids
  enjoy family-friendly TV shows and films in their own space.
  
  Kids profiles come with PIN-protected parental controls that let you restrict the maturity rating
  of content kids can watch and block specific titles you don’t want kids to see.

# Safety and Security Solutions
# with Contract Pricing.

Safeware provides safety and security solutions for first responders, schools, and government
agencies. Using multiple cooperative contracts, Safeware ensures cost-effective and reliable
protection when it matters most.

[ REQUEST A QUOTE ][148]
[ [Safeware logo] ][149]

## [Wildfire Preparedness, Response and Recovery Solutions][150]

Safeware supports responders, emergency managers, and public agencies before, during, and after
wildland fire events with solutions that help improve awareness, strengthen communication, protect
personnel, support evacuations, and keep critical operations moving.

[ LEARN MORE NOW ][151]
[ [Safeware logo] ][152]

## [Flood Mitigation and Emergency Response Solutions][153]

Safeware is a trusted partner to flood and disaster response teams, ready to provide critical
support before, during, and after a crisis. Whether rescuing those in harm’s way or leading recovery
and cleanup efforts, we equip responders with the solutions they need to act swiftly, safely, and
confidently.

[ LEARN MORE ][154]
[ [Active Shooter Prevention Project Logo] ][155]

## [Comprehensive Safety & Security Solutions for Schools and Campuses][156]

Protect your campus with trusted solutions—metal detectors, security window film, panic alarms,
surveillance, emergency kits, and more—tailored to the unique needs of schools and universities.
Safeware helps educators and administrators create safer learning environments and respond
effectively to any emergency.

### Company profile

Senken was Founded in 1990, the largest Chinese manufacturer of special vehicle signal lights and
alarm equipments, specializes in researching, developing, producing and selling police appliances,
safety engineering appliances, special lighting equipments, urban air defense warning equipments,
and various protective safety equipments. Senken has a total registered capital of RMB 111 million
with more than 1000 employees.

### Why choose us

Senken is an enterprise with certificate ISO9001 and ISO140000. And majority of our products for
export were certified to CE, E-MARK, UL,etc.
Innovation has always been the main object for Senken's development in the past two decades.
Senken has various professional technicians in its R&D center, makes deep study in product
industrial design, mechanical research, electronics, acoustics, optics and technological design ect.
At present, Senken has successfully developed more than 100 series, over 1000 varieties of products,
and has been granted more than 200 patents. Now Senken has been honored to be one of Top 100
Enterprises in China.

# who protect us

## About Us

At SMPP, our mission is to deliver sophisticated and high-quality defense products that meet the
ever-evolving needs of our clients, reinforcing their trust in our technological capabilities and
unwavering commitment to excellence.

[Know Our Story][29]

## WHAT WE DO

Our passion lies in the confidence our products instill in users. We are committed to offering
technologically advanced, high-quality products and solutions, leveraging our expertise to meet our
customers' diverse needs.

##### Personal Protection

Our personal protection products include bullet-resistant jackets, armor plates, ballistic helmets,
and shields. These products are tailored for armed forces, police, and paramilitary personnel,
offering protection against various threats in different environments.

[Know More ][30]

##### Platform Protection

We provide armor solutions for vehicles, patrol boats, aircraft, and helicopters. These protection
kits are designed to enhance survivability during combat and anti-terror operations, ensuring
critical areas are shielded against blasts and projectiles.

[Know More ][31]

##### Ammunition

In the Ammunition vertical, we are the oldest Private sector company in India to manufacture
Combustible Cartridge Cases (CCCs) of 120mm and 125mm calibers for Tanks, 105mm (MCS), 130mm (MCS)
and 155mm (BMCS/UMCS) calibers for Artillery Guns and Augmenting Cartridges for 51mm, 81mm and 120mm
Mortars for Infantry and Artillery.

[Know More ][32]

##### Ceramic Plates

We manufacture bullet-resistant hard armor plates using boron carbide ceramics. These lightweight
plates provide advanced protection, including resistance to armor-piercing bullets, and are used
across various defense and industrial applications.

[Know More ][33]

and Supplies, Ministry of Defence, Government of India 1998

Defence, Government of India 2018

SIDM Championship Award for technology product innovation to address defence capability gaps 2020

Recognised by the Ministry of Defence, Government of India for the supply of 100,000th bullet proof
jacket to Indian Armed Forces, four months ahead of delivery schedule 2021

# Protecting those
# who protect us

## About Us

At SMPP, our mission is to deliver sophisticated and high-quality defense products that meet the
ever-evolving needs of our clients, reinforcing their trust in our technological capabilities and
unwavering commitment to excellence.

[Know Our Story][29]

## WHAT WE DO

Our passion lies in the confidence our products instill in users. We are committed to offering
technologically advanced, high-quality products and solutions, leveraging our expertise to meet our
customers' diverse needs.

##### Personal Protection

Our personal protection products include bullet-resistant jackets, armor plates, ballistic helmets,
and shields. These products are tailored for armed forces, police, and paramilitary personnel,
offering protection against various threats in different environments.

[Know More ][30]

##### Platform Protection

We provide armor solutions for vehicles, patrol boats, aircraft, and helicopters. These protection
kits are designed to enhance survivability during combat and anti-terror operations, ensuring
critical areas are shielded against blasts and projectiles.

[Know More ][31]

##### Ammunition

In the Ammunition vertical, we are the oldest Private sector company in India to manufacture
Combustible Cartridge Cases (CCCs) of 120mm and 125mm calibers for Tanks, 105mm (MCS), 130mm (MCS)
and 155mm (BMCS/UMCS) calibers for Artillery Guns and Augmenting Cartridges for 51mm, 81mm and 120mm
Mortars for Infantry and Artillery.

[Know More ][32]

##### Ceramic Plates

We manufacture bullet-resistant hard armor plates using boron carbide ceramics. These lightweight
plates provide advanced protection, including resistance to armor-piercing bullets, and are used
across various defense and industrial applications.

[Know More ][33]

you can take pride in knowing that your helmet was made just for you.
